planets.name: HATS-71 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HATS-71 with a 3.8-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: HATS-71 b was found in 2020 by HATSouth as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HATS-71. Its orbit and size follow Bakos et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
